mods.name: Loot Rush
mods.description: Competitive scavenger-race minigame with random target items, lives, swaps, and multilingual UI.

mods.name: Loot Rush
mods.description: LootRush is a competitive “scavenge race” mini-game that keeps every round tense from the first second to the final grab. Players are scattered to safe random locations, a target item is announced, and the hunt begins: be the first to obtain it - or outlast everyone else, remember that players switch places every 5 minutes. To keep the pace high and the round fair, LootRush adds a lives system (with automatic spectator handling), a clean scoreboard with a running timer, and periodic random position swaps with warnings so nobody can camp the same spot forever. Teleportation is built for real servers: chunks are preloaded, progress is shown via BossBar, and players receive a short invulnerability window after being moved.

releases.notes:
- full migration to Minecraft 26.2 completed for Paper, NeoForge, and Fabric.
- build and dependency stack updated to current versions, with Java 25 required across all targets.
- added persistent ban-list management commands: `/lr banlist`, `/lr banlist add <item|REGEX:...>`, and `/lr banlist remove <item|REGEX:...>`.
- added Fabric configuration and brought its gameplay flow, commands, safe teleports, lives, scoreboards, swaps, and localization closer to platform parity.

- added banlist management commands: /lr banlist, /lr banlist add <item|REGEX:...>, /lr banlist remove <item|REGEX:...>.
- updated gameplay/service compatibility with 26.x API changes (world time handling, events, bossbar/teleport related updates).
- stabilized build pipeline and tests for plugin/mod modules; refreshed project docs for the 26.x support line.

releases.notes:
- New debug mode. Now all unwanted messages (for regular players) go to `/lr debug`.
- For greater surprise, chat messages have been removed from the swap. Now, you can only determine an impending swap using the bossbar.
- All bugs in NeoForge version have been fixed, and the first release version of the mod is now ready.
- Minor fixes and improvements
